summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) ControlCode variant; rich/control.py adds the title sequence format (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title(title) for each title control; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title), gated on is_terminal and returning a bool; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was committed. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions, so the changes are verified only by reading. Choices to check: set_window_title uses the is_terminal gate that show_cursor uses, and the console test skips on sys.platform == "win32", which also skips modern Windows.
